uncertain_points.claim: The comment claims that for non-DOM S-Box implementations, only prd_q bits are used and other bits are tied to 0. This connection must be verified in the instantiation logic elsewhere.
uncertain_points.cond: always, for any non-DOM S-Box instances in this module
uncertain_points.risk: If unused S-Box output bits are not actually tied to 0, floating or incorrectly connected bits could leak side-channel information or break masking protections.
